# Espresso

[Index](../index.md) · [Rules](../rules.md) · [Sources](../sources.md)

A short, strong shot pulled through finely ground coffee.

- Is a: [PureEspresso](c-pure-espresso.md)
- Disjoint with: [Americano](c-americano.md), [LongBlack](c-long-black.md), [Lungo](c-lungo.md), [Ristretto](c-ristretto.md)
